result.headline: No single cause dominates this zone; a capacity strain across many people is the most likely contributor [capacity_strain][zone_overview].
result.explanation: The zone is an improvement opportunity, not poorly served, with 82,067 people across 108 cells [zone_overview]. Speeds fell 55% from the oldest to the latest quarter [zone_overview], and 22,126 people are in busy cells with a capacity-strain signal [capacity_strain]. Operator scarcity is not universal because the zone average is 2.7 operators nearby [zone_overview]. The rule-based fix is to gather measurements first because no single weakness dominates [fix_rule].
